idea.title: Real listing: photo dump vs the order that sells
idea.angle: Using one real listing's photos: the random order agents usually post, then the same photos re-ordered from hero shot to neighbourhood. The change is the order, not the house. Text-only before/after (captions, post layouts, first lines) — no house photos.

slides.heading: SAME PHOTOS. NEW ORDER. **LOOK**.
slides.body: Take an example 4-bed family home. Nothing about the house changes. Only the order.

slides.heading: POSTED IN THE ORDER YOU **TOOK** THEM
slides.body: Gate first. Then a corridor. Then a bathroom. Buyers decide in about a second if they'll keep looking.

slides.heading: THEY SWIPE AWAY AFTER **PHOTO ONE**
slides.body: The pool and garden are near the end. Most buyers never get that far. The best part of the home stays hidden.

slides.heading: FIX THE **FIRST** PHOTO
slides.body:
Before: Photo 1 is the front gate.
After: Photo 1 is the hero shot.
✓ The pool and garden, in daylight
✓ Bold text: "4-bed with pool, quiet street"

slides.heading: PUT THE ROOMS IN **ORDER**
slides.body:
Before: Gate, corridor, bathroom, kitchen, bedroom, pool.
After:
✓ Hero shot, living room, kitchen
✓ Master bedroom, master bathroom
✓ Other bedrooms
✓ Pool, then the neighbourhood

slides.heading: FROM PHOTO DUMP TO **STORY**
slides.body:
Before: Twenty photos in random order.
After: Eight photos that tell the home's story.
✓ Each one shows a new space
✓ Ends with the area nearby

slides.heading: The house didn't change. The order did.
slides.body: Lead with your best shot, even if it's not the front.

slides.heading: GET **THE ORDER** THAT SELLS
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
Same photos, same house. The only thing that changed is the order.

Most listings go up in the order the photos were taken: gate, corridor, bathroom.
Buyers decide in about a second, so they swipe away.
Lead with the hero shot. Then living room, kitchen, master bedroom, master bathroom, other bedrooms, standout feature and the neighbourhood.
You already have the photos. Just change the order.

What's the first photo on your latest listing?

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
